passages.text: “And I, in the first year of Darius the Mede, stood up to strengthen and protect him.
passages.sermon:
I am the speaker in this passage.
I am a heavenly messenger.
Darius the Mede was king.
It was the first year of his reign.
I stood up during that year.
I acted to strengthen Darius.
I acted to protect Darius.
passages.original: וַאֲנִי֙ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֔ת לְדָרְיָ֖וֶשׁ הַמָּדִ֑י עָמְדִ֛י לְמַחֲזִ֥יק וּלְמָע֖וֹז לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Now then, I will tell you the truth: Three more kings will arise in Persia, and then a fourth, who will be far richer than all the others. By the power of his wealth, he will stir up everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
passages.sermon:
I will tell you the truth now.
Three more kings will rise in Persia.
A fourth king will come after them.
This fourth king will be richer than all the others.
His great wealth will give him power.
He will use his power to stir up everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה אֱמֶ֖ת אַגִּ֣יד לָ֑ךְ הִנֵּה־ עוֹד֩ שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה מְלָכִ֜ים עֹמְדִ֣ים לְפָרַ֗ס וְהָֽרְבִיעִי֙ יַעֲשִׁ֤יר עֹֽשֶׁר־ גָּדוֹל֙ מִכֹּ֔ל וּכְחֶזְקָת֣וֹ בְעָשְׁר֔וֹ יָעִ֣יר הַכֹּ֔ל אֵ֖ת מַלְכ֥וּת יָוָֽן׃

passages.text: Then a mighty king will arise, who will rule with great authority and do as he pleases.
passages.sermon:
A mighty king will arise.
This king will have great power.
He will rule with much authority.
He will do whatever he wants.
passages.original: וְעָמַ֖ד מֶ֣לֶךְ גִּבּ֑וֹר וּמָשַׁל֙ מִמְשָׁ֣ל רַ֔ב וְעָשָׂ֖ה כִּרְצוֹנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But as soon as he is established, his kingdom will be broken up and parceled out toward the four winds of heaven. It will not go to his descendants, nor will it have the authority with which he ruled, because his kingdom will be uprooted and given to others.
passages.sermon:
A mighty king will arise.
He will rule with great authority.
He will do as he pleases.
When he becomes strong, his kingdom will break apart.
People will divide his kingdom into four parts.
They will spread it toward the four winds of heaven.
His descendants will not receive his kingdom.
His kingdom will not have the same power he had.
Others will take his kingdom.
God will uproot his kingdom and give it to different people.
passages.original: וּכְעָמְדוֹ֙ תִּשָּׁבֵ֣ר מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְתֵחָ֕ץ לְאַרְבַּ֖ע רוּח֣וֹת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְלֹ֣א לְאַחֲרִית֗וֹ וְלֹ֤א כְמָשְׁלוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָשָׁ֔ל כִּ֤י תִנָּתֵשׁ֙ מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְלַאֲחֵרִ֖ים מִלְּבַד־ אֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: The king of the South will grow strong, but one of his commanders will grow even stronger and will rule his own kingdom with great authority.
passages.sermon:
The king of the South will become strong.
One of his commanders will become even stronger than the king.
This commander will rule his own kingdom.
He will have great authority.
passages.original: וְיֶחֱזַ֥ק מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַנֶּ֖גֶב וּמִן־ שָׂרָ֑יו וְיֶחֱזַ֤ק עָלָיו֙ וּמָשָׁ֔ל מִמְשָׁ֥ל רַ֖ב מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: After some years they will form an alliance, and the daughter of the king of the South will go to the king of the North to seal the agreement. But his daughter will not retain her position of power, nor will his strength endure. At that time she will be given up, along with her royal escort and her father and the one who supported her.
passages.sermon:
After some years, the king of the South and the king of the North will form an alliance.
The daughter of the king of the South will go to the king of the North.
She will go to make an agreement between them.
The daughter will not keep her power.
The king of the North will not keep his strength.
The daughter will be handed over.
Her attendants will be handed over.
Her father will be handed over.
The one who supported her will be handed over.
This will happen at that time.
passages.original: וּלְקֵ֤ץ שָׁנִים֙ יִתְחַבָּ֔רוּ וּבַ֣ת מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַנֶּ֗גֶב תָּבוֹא֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת מֵישָׁרִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־ תַעְצֹ֞ר כּ֣וֹחַ הַזְּר֗וֹעַ וְלֹ֤א יַעֲמֹד֙ וּזְרֹע֔וֹ וְתִנָּתֵ֨ן הִ֤יא וּמְבִיאֶ֙יהָ֙ וְהַיֹּ֣לְדָ֔הּ וּמַחֲזִקָ֖הּ בָּעִתִּֽים׃

passages.text: But one from her family line will rise up in his place, come against the army of the king of the North, and enter his fortress, fighting and prevailing.
passages.sermon:
A person from her family line will rise up in her place.
This person will come against the army of the king of the North.
He will enter the fortress of the king of the North.
He will fight against them.
He will prevail over them.
passages.original: וְעָמַ֛ד מִנֵּ֥צֶר שָׁרָשֶׁ֖יהָ כַּנּ֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֣א אֶל־ הַחַ֗יִל וְיָבֹא֙ בְּמָעוֹז֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וְעָשָׂ֥ה בָהֶ֖ם וְהֶחֱזִֽיק׃

passages.text: He will take even their gods captive to Egypt, with their metal images and their precious vessels of silver and gold. For some years he will stay away from the king of the North, who will invade the realm of the king of the South and then return to his own land.
passages.sermon:
A ruler from the South will act.
He will take the gods of the North as captives.
He will also take their princes.
He will seize their valuable treasures.
He will carry away silver and gold vessels.
He will bring all these things to Egypt.
He will stay away from the king of the North for some years.
The king of the North will later enter the kingdom of the South.
Then the king of the North will return to his own land.
passages.original: וְגַ֣ם אֱ‍ֽלֹהֵיהֶ֡ם עִם־ נְסִֽכֵיהֶם֩ עִם־ כְּלֵ֨י חֶמְדָּתָ֜ם כֶּ֧סֶף וְזָהָ֛ב בַּשְּׁבִ֖י יָבִ֣א מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהוּא֙ שָׁנִ֣ים יַעֲמֹ֔ד מִמֶּ֖לֶךְ הַצָּפֽוֹן׃ וּבָ֗א בְּמַלְכוּת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֔גֶב וְשָׁ֖ב אֶל־ אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But his sons will stir up strife and assemble a great army, which will advance forcefully, sweeping through like a flood, and will again carry the battle as far as his fortress.
passages.sermon:
The sons of the king will cause conflict.
They will gather a very large army.
This army will move forward with great force.
The army will sweep through the land like a flood.
They will pass through and continue the battle.
They will fight all the way to the strong fortress.
passages.original: וּבְנוֹ יִתְגָּר֗וּ וְאָסְפוּ֙ הֲמוֹן֙ חֲיָלִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וּבָ֥א ב֖וֹא וְשָׁטַ֣ף וְעָבָ֑ר וְיָשֹׁ֥ב וְיִתְגָּרוּ עַד־ מָעֻזָּה׃

passages.text: In a rage, the king of the South will march out to fight the king of the North, who will raise a large army, but it will be delivered into the hand of his enemy.
passages.sermon:
The king of the South will become very angry.
He will march out to fight.
He will fight against the king of the North.
The king of the North will gather a large army.
The large army will be given into the hand of the king of the South.
The king of the South will defeat the army of the king of the North.
passages.original: וְיִתְמַרְמַר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֔גֶב וְיָצָ֕א וְנִלְחַ֥ם עִמּ֖וֹ עִם־ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֑וֹן וְהֶעֱמִיד֙ הָמ֣וֹן רָ֔ב וְנִתַּ֥ן הֶהָמ֖וֹן בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: When the army is carried off, the king of the South will be proud in heart and will cast down tens of thousands, but he will not triumph.
passages.sermon:
The king of the South will become proud.
His heart will be lifted up.
He will defeat tens of thousands.
He will not win the final victory.
passages.original: וְנִשָּׂ֥א הֶהָמ֖וֹן יָרוּם לְבָב֑וֹ וְהִפִּ֛יל רִבֹּא֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א יָעֽוֹז׃

passages.text: For the king of the North will raise another army, larger than the first, and after some years he will advance with a great army and many supplies.
passages.sermon:
The king of the North will return.
He will gather a large army.
This army will be bigger than the first army.
After some years, the king of the North will come again.
He will come with a great army.
He will bring much wealth and many supplies.
passages.original: וְשָׁב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וְהֶעֱמִ֣יד הָמ֔וֹן רַ֖ב מִן־ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וּלְקֵ֨ץ הָֽעִתִּ֤ים שָׁנִים֙ יָ֣בוֹא ב֔וֹא בְּחַ֥יִל גָּד֖וֹל וּבִרְכ֥וּשׁ רָֽב׃

passages.text: In those times many will rise up against the king of the South. Violent ones among your own people will exalt themselves in fulfillment of the vision, but they will fail.
passages.sermon:
Many people will oppose the king of the South.
Some of your own people are violent.
These violent people will try to fulfill the vision.
They will not succeed.
They will fail.
passages.original: וּבָעִתִּ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם רַבִּ֥ים יַֽעַמְד֖וּ עַל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֑גֶב וּבְנֵ֣י׀ פָּרִיצֵ֣י עַמְּךָ֗ יִֽנַּשְּׂא֛וּ לְהַעֲמִ֥יד חָז֖וֹן וְנִכְשָֽׁלוּ׃

passages.text: Then the king of the North will come, build up a siege ramp, and capture a fortified city. The forces of the South will not stand; even their best troops will not be able to resist.
passages.sermon:
The king of the North will come.
He will build a siege ramp.
He will capture a fortified city.
The forces of the South will not stand.
Even the best troops of the South will not be able to resist.
They will have no strength to stand.
passages.original: וְיָבֹא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וְיִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ סֽוֹלֲלָ֔ה וְלָכַ֖ד עִ֣יר מִבְצָר֑וֹת וּזְרֹע֤וֹת הַנֶּ֙גֶב֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔דוּ וְעַם֙ מִבְחָרָ֔יו וְאֵ֥ין כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲמֹֽד׃

passages.text: The invader will do as he pleases, and no one will stand against him. He will establish himself in the Beautiful Land, with destruction in his hand.
passages.sermon:
The invader will act as he wishes.
No one will stand against the invader.
The invader will enter the Beautiful Land.
He will bring destruction with him.
passages.original: וְיַ֨עַשׂ הַבָּ֤א אֵלָיו֙ כִּרְצוֹנ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥ין עוֹמֵ֖ד לְפָנָ֑יו וְיַעֲמֹ֥ד בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ הַצְּבִ֖י וְכָלָ֥ה בְיָדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He will resolve to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and will reach an agreement with the king of the South. He will give him a daughter in marriage in order to overthrow the kingdom, but his plan will not succeed or help him.
passages.sermon:
The king of the North will act with determination.
He will come with the full strength of his kingdom.
He will bring upright people with him.
He will make an agreement with the king of the South.
He will give his daughter in marriage to the king of the South.
He does this to destroy the southern kingdom.
His plan will not succeed.
His daughter will not help him.
His plan will not benefit him.
passages.original: וְיָשֵׂ֣ם׀ פָּ֠נָיו לָב֞וֹא בְּתֹ֧קֶף כָּל־ מַלְכוּת֛וֹ וִישָׁרִ֥ים עִמּ֖וֹ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וּבַ֤ת הַנָּשִׁים֙ יִתֶּן־ ל֣וֹ לְהַשְׁחִיתָ֔הּ וְלֹ֥א תַעֲמֹ֖ד וְלֹא־ ל֥וֹ תִהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: Then he will turn his face to the coastlands and capture many of them. But a commander will put an end to his reproach and will turn it back upon him.
passages.sermon:
The invader is a powerful ruler.
He will turn his attention to the coastlands.
He will attack the coastlands.
He will capture many places there.
A commander will oppose him.
The commander will stop the invader’s shame.
The commander will return the shame to the invader.
passages.original: וְיָשֵׁב פָּנָ֛יו לְאִיִּ֖ים וְלָכַ֣ד רַבִּ֑ים וְהִשְׁבִּ֨ית קָצִ֤ין חֶרְפָּתוֹ֙ ל֔וֹ בִּלְתִּ֥י חֶרְפָּת֖וֹ יָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: After this, he will turn back toward the fortresses of his own land, but he will stumble and fall and be no more.
passages.sermon:
A powerful king will act with strength and cunning.
He will try to expand his kingdom.
He will face many challenges.
After these events, he will return to the strongholds in his own land.
He will stumble.
He will fall.
People will not find him anymore.
passages.original: וְיָשֵׁ֣ב פָּנָ֔יו לְמָעוּזֵּ֖י אַרְצ֑וֹ וְנִכְשַׁ֥ל וְנָפַ֖ל וְלֹ֥א יִמָּצֵֽא׃

passages.text: In his place one will arise who will send out a tax collector for the glory of the kingdom; but within a few days he will be destroyed, though not in anger or in battle.
passages.sermon:
A new ruler will take the throne.
This ruler will send out a tax collector.
The tax collector will collect wealth for the kingdom’s glory.
After a few days, this ruler will be destroyed.
He will not die because of anger.
He will not die in battle.
passages.original: וְעָמַ֧ד עַל־ כַּנּ֛וֹ מַעֲבִ֥יר נוֹגֵ֖שׂ הֶ֣דֶר מַלְכ֑וּת וּבְיָמִ֤ים אֲחָדִים֙ יִשָּׁבֵ֔ר וְלֹ֥א בְאַפַּ֖יִם וְלֹ֥א בְמִלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: In his place a despicable person will arise; royal honors will not be given to him, but he will come in a time of peace and seize the kingdom by intrigue.
passages.sermon:
A despicable person will arise in his place.
People will not give him royal honors.
He will come during a time of peace.
He will seize the kingdom by using intrigue.
passages.original: וְעָמַ֤ד עַל־ כַּנּוֹ֙ נִבְזֶ֔ה וְלֹא־ נָתְנ֥וּ עָלָ֖יו ה֣וֹד מַלְכ֑וּת וּבָ֣א בְשַׁלְוָ֔ה וְהֶחֱזִ֥יק מַלְכ֖וּת בַּחֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Then a flood of forces will be swept away before him and destroyed, along with a prince of the covenant.
passages.sermon:
A despicable person will arise.
He will not receive royal honors.
He will come in a time of peace.
He will seize the kingdom by intrigue.
Many powerful forces will stand before him.
He will sweep these forces away.
He will destroy them.
He will also destroy a prince of the covenant.
passages.original: וּזְרֹע֥וֹת הַשֶּׁ֛טֶף יִשָּׁטְפ֥וּ מִלְּפָנָ֖יו וְיִשָּׁבֵ֑רוּ וְגַ֖ם נְגִ֥יד בְּרִֽית׃

passages.text: After an alliance is made with him, he will act deceitfully; for he will rise to power with only a few people.
passages.sermon:
A despicable person will come to power.
People will make an alliance with him.
He will act with deceit.
He will become strong.
He will rise to power with only a few people.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הִֽתְחַבְּר֥וּת אֵלָ֖יו יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִרְמָ֑ה וְעָלָ֥ה וְעָצַ֖ם בִּמְעַט־ גּֽוֹי׃

passages.text: In a time of peace, he will invade the richest provinces and do what his fathers and forefathers never did. He will lavish plunder, loot, and wealth on his followers, and he will plot against the strongholds—but only for a time.
passages.sermon:
A powerful ruler will come during a time of peace.
He will enter the richest provinces.
He will do things his fathers never did.
He will do things his forefathers never did.
He will give plunder to his followers.
He will give loot to his followers.
He will give wealth to his followers.
He will plan attacks against strongholds.
He will do this only for a limited time.
passages.original: בְּשַׁלְוָ֞ה וּבְמִשְׁמַנֵּ֣י מְדִינָה֮ יָבוֹא֒ וְעָשָׂ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ עָשׂ֤וּ אֲבֹתָיו֙ וַאֲב֣וֹת אֲבֹתָ֔יו בִּזָּ֧ה וְשָׁלָ֛ל וּרְכ֖וּשׁ לָהֶ֣ם יִבְז֑וֹר וְעַ֧ל מִבְצָרִ֛ים יְחַשֵּׁ֥ב מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֖יו וְעַד־ עֵֽת׃

passages.text: And with a large army he will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the South, who will mobilize a very large and powerful army but will not withstand the plots devised against him.
passages.sermon:
The king of the North gathers his strength.
He becomes bold.
He brings a large army.
He attacks the king of the South.
The king of the South prepares for war.
He gathers a very large and powerful army.
But the king of the South cannot stand.
People plot against him.
These plots defeat him.
passages.original: וְיָעֵר֩ כֹּח֨וֹ וּלְבָב֜וֹ עַל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּגֶב֮ בְּחַ֣יִל גָּדוֹל֒ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֗גֶב יִתְגָּרֶה֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה בְּחַֽיִל־ גָּד֥וֹל וְעָצ֖וּם עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔ד כִּֽי־ יַחְשְׁב֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מַחֲשָׁבֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Those who eat from his provisions will seek to destroy him; his army will be swept away, and many will fall slain.
passages.sermon:
The king of the South will face betrayal from those close to him.
His own companions, who share his food, will try to destroy him.
His army will be overwhelmed.
Many people will die.
passages.original: וְאֹכְלֵ֧י פַת־ בָּג֛וֹ יִשְׁבְּר֖וּהוּ וְחֵיל֣וֹ יִשְׁט֑וֹף וְנָפְל֖וּ חֲלָלִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: And the two kings, with their hearts bent on evil, will speak lies at the same table, but to no avail, for still the end will come at the appointed time.
passages.sermon:
There are two kings.
Both kings have hearts set on evil.
They sit together at one table.
They speak lies to each other.
Their plans will not succeed.
The end will come only at the appointed time.
passages.original: וּשְׁנֵיהֶ֤ם הַמְּלָכִים֙ לְבָבָ֣ם לְמֵרָ֔ע וְעַל־ שֻׁלְחָ֥ן אֶחָ֖ד כָּזָ֣ב יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְלֹ֣א תִצְלָ֔ח כִּי־ ע֥וֹד קֵ֖ץ לַמּוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: The king of the North will return to his land with great wealth, but his heart will be set against the holy covenant; so he will do damage and return to his own land.
passages.sermon:
The king of the North will return to his own land.
He will bring great wealth with him.
His heart will be set against the holy covenant.
He will do damage to the holy covenant.
Then he will return to his own land.
passages.original: וְיָשֹׁ֤ב אַרְצוֹ֙ בִּרְכ֣וּשׁ גָּד֔וֹל וּלְבָב֖וֹ עַל־ בְּרִ֣ית קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְעָשָׂ֖ה וְשָׁ֥ב לְאַרְצֽוֹ׃

passages.text: At the appointed time he will invade the South again, but this time will not be like the first.
passages.sermon:
The king of the North will act.
He will return at the appointed time.
He will come into the South again.
This invasion will not be like the first time.
This invasion will not be like the last time either.
passages.original: לַמּוֹעֵ֥ד יָשׁ֖וּב וּבָ֣א בַנֶּ֑גֶב וְלֹֽא־ תִהְיֶ֥ה כָרִאשֹׁנָ֖ה וְכָאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃

passages.text: Ships of Kittim will come against him, and he will lose heart. Then he will turn back and rage against the holy covenant and do damage. So he will return and show favor to those who forsake the holy covenant.
passages.sermon:
The king of the North will face ships from Kittim.
These ships will come against him.
He will lose heart.
He will turn back.
He will become angry at the holy covenant.
He will act against the holy covenant.
He will return to his land.
He will show favor to those who abandon the holy covenant.
passages.original: וּבָ֨אוּ ב֜וֹ צִיִּ֤ים כִּתִּים֙ וְנִכְאָ֔ה וְשָׁ֛ב וְזָעַ֥ם עַל־ בְּרִֽית־ ק֖וֹדֶשׁ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וְשָׁ֣ב וְיָבֵ֔ן עַל־ עֹזְבֵ֖י בְּרִ֥ית קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: His forces will rise up and desecrate the temple fortress. They will abolish the daily sacrifice and set up the abomination of desolation.
passages.sermon:
A powerful king will send his forces.
His forces will take action.
They will attack the temple fortress.
They will make the temple fortress unclean.
They will stop the daily sacrifice.
They will put in place the abomination that causes desolation.
passages.original: וּזְרֹעִ֖ים מִמֶּ֣נּוּ יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וְחִלְּל֞וּ הַמִּקְדָּ֤שׁ הַמָּעוֹז֙ וְהֵסִ֣ירוּ הַתָּמִ֔יד וְנָתְנ֖וּ הַשִּׁקּ֥וּץ מְשׁוֹמֵֽם׃

passages.text: With flattery he will corrupt those who violate the covenant, but the people who know their God will firmly resist him.
passages.sermon:
A powerful ruler will use flattery.
He will corrupt people who break the holy covenant.
These people have already turned away from God.
But some people know their God.
These people will stand firm.
They will take action against the ruler.
passages.original: וּמַרְשִׁיעֵ֣י בְרִ֔ית יַחֲנִ֖יף בַּחֲלַקּ֑וֹת וְעַ֛ם יֹדְעֵ֥י אֱלֹהָ֖יו יַחֲזִ֥קוּ וְעָשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: Those with insight will instruct many, though for a time they will fall by sword or flame, or be captured or plundered.
passages.sermon:
Some people have insight.
These people understand God.
They will teach many others.
They will help many people know the truth.
Enemies will attack these wise people.
Some will die by the sword.
Some will die by fire.
Some will be taken as prisoners.
Some will lose their possessions.
This will happen for a period of time.
passages.original: וּמַשְׂכִּ֣ילֵי עָ֔ם יָבִ֖ינוּ לָֽרַבִּ֑ים וְנִכְשְׁל֞וּ בְּחֶ֧רֶב וּבְלֶהָבָ֛ה בִּשְׁבִ֥י וּבְבִזָּ֖ה יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: Now when they fall, they will be granted a little help, but many will join them insincerely.
passages.sermon:
Some people with insight will fall.
They will receive a little help.
Many people will join them.
These people will not join sincerely.
They will act with false intentions.
passages.original: וּבְהִכָּ֣שְׁלָ֔ם יֵעָזְר֖וּ עֵ֣זֶר מְעָ֑ט וְנִלְו֧וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם רַבִּ֖ים בַּחֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Some of the wise will fall, so that they may be refined, purified, and made spotless until the time of the end, for it will still come at the appointed time.
passages.sermon:
Some of the wise will fall.
God will use their fall to refine them.
God will purify them.
God will make them spotless.
This will continue until the time of the end.
The end will come at the appointed time.
God has set this time.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הַמַּשְׂכִּילִ֣ים יִכָּֽשְׁל֗וּ לִצְר֥וֹף בָּהֶ֛ם וּלְבָרֵ֥ר וְלַלְבֵּ֖ן עַד־ עֵ֣ת קֵ֑ץ כִּי־ ע֖וֹד לַמּוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: Then the king will do as he pleases and will exalt and magnify himself above every god, and he will speak monstrous things against the God of gods. He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been decreed must be accomplished.
passages.sermon:
The king will act as he wishes.
He will exalt himself.
He will make himself great above every god.
He will speak astonishing things against the God of gods.
He will succeed until the time of wrath is finished.
God has decreed this.
What God has decided will happen.
passages.original: וְעָשָׂ֨ה כִרְצוֹנ֜וֹ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְיִתְרוֹמֵ֤ם וְיִתְגַּדֵּל֙ עַל־ כָּל־ אֵ֔ל וְעַל֙ אֵ֣ל אֵלִ֔ים יְדַבֵּ֖ר נִפְלָא֑וֹת וְהִצְלִ֙יחַ֙ עַד־ כָּ֣לָה זַ֔עַם כִּ֥י נֶחֱרָצָ֖ה נֶעֱשָֽׂתָה׃

passages.text: He will show no regard for the gods of his fathers, nor for the one desired by women, nor for any other god, because he will magnify himself above them all.
passages.sermon:
A king will come.
This king will not respect the gods of his fathers.
He will not honor the one desired by women.
He will not respect any other god.
He will make himself greater than all gods.
passages.original: וְעַל־ אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתָיו֙ לֹ֣א יָבִ֔ין וְעַל־ חֶמְדַּ֥ת נָשִׁ֛ים וְעַֽל־ כָּל־ אֱל֖וֹהַּ לֹ֣א יָבִ֑ין כִּ֥י עַל־ כֹּ֖ל יִתְגַּדָּֽל׃

passages.text: And in their place, he will honor a god of fortresses—a god his fathers did not know—with gold, silver, precious stones, and riches.
passages.sermon:
The king will honor a god of fortresses.
This god is not the god his fathers knew.
The king will give this god gold.
He will give this god silver.
He will give this god precious stones.
He will give this god riches.
passages.original: וְלֶאֱלֹ֙הַּ֙ מָֽעֻזִּ֔ים עַל־ כַּנּ֖וֹ יְכַבֵּ֑ד וְלֶאֱל֜וֹהַּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־ יְדָעֻ֣הוּ אֲבֹתָ֗יו יְכַבֵּ֛ד בְּזָהָ֥ב וּבְכֶ֛סֶף וּבְאֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָ֖ה וּבַחֲמֻדֽוֹת׃

passages.text: He will attack the strongest fortresses with the help of a foreign god and will greatly honor those who acknowledge him, making them rulers over many and distributing the land for a price.
passages.sermon:
A powerful king will act against the strongest fortresses.
He will use the help of a foreign god.
He will honor those who acknowledge this foreign god.
He will give them great honor.
He will make them rulers over many people.
He will divide the land among them for a price.
passages.original: וְעָשָׂ֞ה לְמִבְצְרֵ֤י מָֽעֻזִּים֙ עִם־ אֱל֣וֹהַּ נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִכִּיר יַרְבֶּ֣ה כָב֑וֹד וְהִמְשִׁילָם֙ בָּֽרַבִּ֔ים וַאֲדָמָ֖ה יְחַלֵּ֥ק בִּמְחִֽיר׃

passages.text: At the time of the end, the king of the South will engage him in battle, but the king of the North will storm out against him with chariots, horsemen, and many ships, invading many countries and sweeping through them like a flood.
passages.sermon:
At the time of the end, two kings will fight.
The king of the South will attack him.
The king of the North will respond with great force.
He will come with chariots.
He will come with horsemen.
He will come with many ships.
He will invade many countries.
He will sweep through them like a flood.
passages.original: וּבְעֵ֣ת קֵ֗ץ יִתְנַגַּ֤ח עִמּוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֔גֶב וְיִשְׂתָּעֵ֨ר עָלָ֜יו מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֗וֹן בְּרֶ֙כֶב֙ וּבְפָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וּבָאֳנִיּ֖וֹת רַבּ֑וֹת וּבָ֥א בַאֲרָצ֖וֹת וְשָׁטַ֥ף וְעָבָֽר׃

passages.text: He will also invade the Beautiful Land, and many countries will fall. But these will be delivered from his hand: Edom, Moab, and the leaders of the Ammonites.
passages.sermon:
A powerful king will invade the Beautiful Land.
He will enter this land with force.
Many countries will fall because of him.
He will defeat and conquer these nations.
But some people will escape from his power.
Edom will escape from him.
Moab will escape from him.
The leaders of the Ammonites will also escape from him.
passages.original: וּבָא֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַצְּבִ֔י וְרַבּ֖וֹת יִכָּשֵׁ֑לוּ וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ יִמָּלְט֣וּ מִיָּד֔וֹ אֱד֣וֹם וּמוֹאָ֔ב וְרֵאשִׁ֖ית בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: He will extend his power over many countries, and not even the land of Egypt will escape.
passages.sermon:
The king of the North will act with great power.
He will reach out his hand over many countries.
He will take control of these lands.
Egypt will not escape from him.
Egypt will fall under his power.
passages.original: וְיִשְׁלַ֥ח יָד֖וֹ בַּאֲרָצ֑וֹת וְאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה לִפְלֵיטָֽה׃

passages.text: He will gain control of the treasures of gold and silver and over all the riches of Egypt, and the Libyans and Cushites will also submit to him.
passages.sermon:
A powerful ruler will come.
He will take control of great treasures.
He will rule over gold and silver.
He will possess all the riches of Egypt.
The people of Libya will follow him.
The people of Cush will also follow him.
passages.original: וּמָשַׁ֗ל בְּמִכְמַנֵּי֙ הַזָּהָ֣ב וְהַכֶּ֔סֶף וּבְכֹ֖ל חֲמֻד֣וֹת מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֻבִ֥ים וְכֻשִׁ֖ים בְּמִצְעָדָֽיו׃

passages.text: But news from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will go out with great fury to destroy many and devote them to destruction.
passages.sermon:
A powerful ruler will hear news from the east and from the north.
This news will alarm him.
He will become very angry.
He will go out in great fury.
He will destroy many people.
He will set many apart for destruction.
passages.original: וּשְׁמֻע֣וֹת יְבַהֲלֻ֔הוּ מִמִּזְרָ֖ח וּמִצָּפ֑וֹן וְיָצָא֙ בְּחֵמָ֣א גְדֹלָ֔ה לְהַשְׁמִ֥יד וּֽלְהַחֲרִ֖ים רַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: He will pitch his royal tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain, but he will meet his end with no one to help him.
passages.sermon:
A powerful ruler will act.
He will set up his royal tents.
He will place them between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain.
He will reach his end.
No one will help him.
passages.original: וְיִטַּע֙ אָהֳלֶ֣י אַפַּדְנ֔וֹ בֵּ֥ין יַמִּ֖ים לְהַר־ צְבִי־ קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּבָא֙ עַד־ קִצּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥ין עוֹזֵ֖ר לֽוֹ׃
